title: R3C-1 frozen same-lineage reproduction gate for open computational Linear A predecessors

scientific_classification.purpose: Measure whether externally published structural/computational results survive JANUS parsing, typing, provenance and no-tuning rules on frozen openly available source lineages.

version_mismatch_policy.reason: The Briakos historical byte snapshot has a published SHA-256, but JANUS has not obtained those exact bytes. A result on the currently frozen mwenge commit is a source-version transport/reproduction test, not exact historical replication.

target_predecessor.authoritative_claim_witness: full thesis PDF, not repository landing-page metadata

target_vector.metadata_conflict: repository landing-page abstract says 0.692; full thesis repeatedly says 0.623; 0.623 is authoritative for this gate

execution_order: R3C_1A reconstruct the exact published corpus-selection and tokenization rules from the thesis methods without inspecting JANUS result deltas
R3C_1B emit an executable method manifest and hash it before metric calculation
R3C_1C compute deterministic corpus/basic distribution metrics
R3C_1D compute stochastic metrics under frozen seed(s) and published permutation count where specified
R3C_1E classify each target as EXACT_MATCH, NUMERIC_COMPATIBLE, SOURCE_VERSION_DIVERGENCE, METHOD_UNDERDETERMINED, or FAIL
R3C_1F publish all targets including failures; no target may be removed after execution

anti_overfit_rules.if_multiple_reasonable_interpretations_e: run all frozen interpretations and report the family; do not select the closest result

extension_gates.R3C_2: logos externally seeded D5/D6 conformance replay and generic transcription-substrate hardening
extension_gates.R3C_4: LevelHeads bounded arithmetic/name-signal reproduction if sufficient public method detail is recoverable

admission_logic.R3C_1_PASS: At least the deterministic target subset is mechanically reproduced or explained by a predeclared source-version/method difference with no target deletion and no tuning.
admission_logic.R3C_1_PARTIAL: Some targets reproduce but one or more remain method-underdetermined or source-version blocked.
admission_logic.R3C_1_FAIL: A mechanically comparable target disagrees outside the frozen tolerance and no predeclared source/version explanation applies.
